subject.title: fix(cli-runner): use sender metadata in CLI session history user labels

question: Should CLI reseed history trust only canonical `message.__openclaw` sender metadata, or also support higher-priority top-level sender fields as a permanent transcript contract?
rationale: The merged writer establishes the envelope, while this PR adds a second source that changes participant identity presented to the model; repository policy treats that prompt and session trust boundary as maintainer-owned unless a shipped producer contract is proven.

options.title: Envelope only
options.body: Read normalized sender identity only from `message.__openclaw`, retaining `User` for legacy rows without canonical metadata.

options.title: Approve both shapes
options.body: Keep top-level precedence only after documenting a trusted shipped producer and adding tests for conflicting and untrusted values.

recommendation.title: Envelope only
recommendation.body: Read normalized sender identity only from `message.__openclaw`, retaining `User` for legacy rows without canonical metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged persistence work defines the current durable sender envelope and the surrounding hook/redaction behavior.
